title: Lower execution cost for v8.6: no-trade band size, cost-aware band, rebalancing to the band edge; per-sleeve cost decomposition (execution design, not alpha)
baseline: Gen327 E: net positions, Bybit funding, per-coin Bybit cost, $1,000 band to target (3.027); also under the Gen337 maker model (limit at the previous close, 2 bp trade-through, else taker one hour later)

variants.cost-aware band: band per coin = $1,000 x coin cost / median cost (expensive coins trade less)
variants.to band edge $1,000 / $2,000: when outside the band, trade only to the band edge (|target - position| = band) instead of to the target (optimal rule for proportional costs); a zero target still closes fully

adopt: a variant replaces the $1,000 band only if it raises the Sharpe in every period (2022, TEST, HOLD) under BOTH cost models; otherwise the current band stays
decomposition: gross turnover cost of each daily sleeve before netting (at the median Bybit cost) vs its gross P&L, and the saving from netting
